title: The Council's Letter
hook: The Okuna council seeks a courier for a sealed letter east — proof of mandate, and a target on your back.
rumor: The council's seal weighs heavier than your pack.
epilogueComplete: The council's letter reached its destination — and your name rode with it.

title: Refugee Escort
hook: A family of refugees beg for an escort to the eastern garrison before the roads close.
epilogueComplete: The refugees reached the garrison because you stayed on the road with them.

title: Okuna Debt
hook: A moneylender in Okuna reminds you: gold borrowed here must be repaid in Vorishy — with interest, if Roachak's shadow doesn't claim you first.
rumor: Every day on the road is a day closer to ruin or redemption.
epilogueComplete: You settled your debt in Vorishy — one worry fewer before Roachak.

title: The Missing Rider
hook: Word on the road says your sibling rode east six months ago and never returned. Someone may know more along the way.
rumor: You tell yourself you are not chasing a ghost.
epilogueComplete: You found what became of your sibling — not the answer you hoped for, but an answer.

title: Witness to the Fall
hook: The priesthood offers absolution to any pilgrim who reaches Roachak and witnesses the sorcerer's fall — or dies trying.
rumor: Penance wears the shape of a hundred days.
epilogueComplete: The priesthood recorded your witness — penance earned on the hundredth mile.

title: The Hidden Relic
hook: A merchant consortium in Okuna pays well for escort work — a relic bound for Vorishy before the hundredth day.
rumor: The relic is hidden. The contract is not.
epilogueComplete: The relic reached Vorishy under your guard — and the consortium paid every coin promised.

title: Roadside Oath
hook: After bandits burned your village, you swore to warn every traveler on this road — but the miles ahead will test that vow.
rumor: They called you fool. You called it duty.
epilogueComplete: Travelers along the road still speak of the fool who kept their oath.

title: Forbidden Texts
hook: A scholar in Okuna believes texts in Roachak's vault could save or damn the world — and wants proof brought back.
rumor: The scholar's curiosity may outlive the scholar.
epilogueComplete: You brought back what the scholar sought — knowledge Roachak would rather have kept buried.
